name: light-leak
title: Light leak
description: A warm, streaked leak of light from one edge. It can cover a cut between two clips.

props.name: src
props.doc: Picture in public/ (used when no children are given).

props.name: toSrc
props.doc: Second picture, cut to at the peak of the leak. Empty for a single picture.

props.name: peakFrame
props.doc: Frame the leak is at its fullest (and the cut, when there is a second picture).

props.name: duration
props.doc: Frames the whole leak lasts, from first glow to gone.

props.name: strength
props.doc: How strong the leak is at its peak. 1 floods most of the frame in warm light; 0.5 is a glow at the edge.

props.name: edge
props.doc: The edge the light comes in from.

props.name: sweep
props.doc: How far the leak travels along the edge while it plays (0 holds it in place).

props.name: softness
props.doc: How far the glow spreads into the frame. Higher is a larger, softer leak.

props.name: streaks
props.doc: How much the glow breaks into streaks (0 is a smooth gradient).

props.name: grain
props.doc: Film grain over the whole frame (0 for none).

props.name: colors.core
props.doc: The hot centre of the leak.
